author: moxfmc
quote: Too much of the drudgery of real life. Lucia is a constant and obnoxious nag that you can't get rid of. Her "honey do" list is never ending. Also the surprise porn that pops up means I have to go hide in my own house to play this game while avoiding my real life honey do list. This game was supposed to let you play out your wildest impulses like all of the others. Instead you're just a sidekick for this annoying woman. Oh and the whole game is built around pandering to her child's questionable legitimacy. Jason needs a paternity test STAT. No way in hell he's the biological father. Welcome to the beta-cuck, broken male simulator.
